required_findings.criteria: Separates the native application, embedded web content, and downloadable non-web document instead of treating the complete product as web content.

Uses EN 301 549 self-scoping: evaluates applicable common and software requirements for native UI, web requirements for WebView content, and non-web document requirements for the PDF without claiming that these are the only potentially applicable clauses.
Explains that the latest ETSI publication is not automatically the edition cited under every Directive, national measure, procurement term, or contract.
Requires the covered product or service, applicable Directive, jurisdiction, national implementation, contract, exemptions, and relevant Annex mapping to be established before a legal claim.
Requires release-specific evidence for each in-scope surface, including manual assistive-technology checks and documented limitations rather than one automated scan.

forbidden_claims: Treats every mobile surface as web content
States that clause 9 alone covers the complete product without self-scoping
Treats the latest published edition as automatically legally applicable
Guarantees conformity from one automated scan
